issue.title: Unnumbered =x Work Log bullets
issue.description: Work Log bullets under a whole-item `=x` close need a leading task number only when bullet order cannot say which task each bullet logs to. `=x3,4` plus `- foo bar` and `- baz bam` writes exactly what `- 3 foo bar` and `- 4 baz bam` write, and `bob capture`, `bob capture-parse`, dry-run previews, and Bob Mac Capture all agree on that.
